# Audit Bench Ai

Audit Bench Ai is an AI code review product that combines LLM reasoning with static analysis to catch security holes, logic bugs, and framework misuse before code ships.

## Start here

- [Homepage](/)
- [Pricing](/pricing)
- [Features](/features)
- [Services](/services)
- [Blog](/blog)
- [Alignment Lab](/alignment-lab)

## Supported workflows

- [GitHub pull request review](/features)
- [GitLab merge request review](/features)
- [Repository scans](/services)
- [Single-file audits](/services)
- [CLI usage in CI pipelines](/cli)

## Supported stacks

- [React](/features)
- [Next.js](/features)
- [Node.js](/features)
- [NestJS](/features)
- [Python](/features)

- [Django](/features)
- [Laravel](/features)
- [Spring Boot](/features)
- [Supabase](/features)
- [Deno](/features)
- [Firebase](/features)

## Core product summary

- [Free local checks first](/services)
- [AI only on flagged code](/services)
- [Cached audits by content hash](/services)
- [Daily and monthly usage quotas by plan](/pricing)
- [Inline review comments plus summary and status checks](/features)
